title: 模型图片输入与资料引用增强

security_summary.evidence_gate: catalog_support_image, protocol_state and capability_state are separate; a catalog flag alone can only produce UNVERIFIED; AVAILABLE requires a ProtocolProfile whose evidence_level, source_id, synthetic and checked_at are all stated explicitly
security_summary.profile_defaults: evidence fields have no defaults (omission is a construction error); limits default to 1 image / 1 MiB / 4 MiB total / 4 Mpx and must be raised explicitly to reach the frozen ceiling
security_summary.production_default: the shipped ProtocolRegistry is empty: with a media binding the call fails with MODEL_IMAGE_PROTOCOL_UNVERIFIED before resolving a reference or reading a byte; the unwired MCP path fails earlier with MODEL_IMAGE_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE. Both send nothing
security_summary.input_shape: images is an array of {media_id} objects only; bare strings, paths, URLs, headers, raw bytes and unknown fields are rejected; account, task and staging root are host-bound and absent from the tool schema
security_summary.send_path: MediaAssets.manifest -> prepare_model_bundle -> authorize_model_send -> consume_model_bundle; each OutboundImage is re-checked for media_id, MIME, byte size and sha256 before staging
security_summary.preview: preview() creates no broker bundle and reports the full text_scope (message count, character count, role counts, source ids, per-message sizes) plus the exact image selection, without message bodies, bytes or paths
security_summary.staging: one 0600 file per selected image under a 0700 root, named by a 32-hex token; Node reads an exact name and byte count with symlink refusal and sha256 verification and deletes the file immediately; Python deletes leftovers in finally; crash residue is swept by the NEXT image request after 900 seconds (no background timer)
security_summary.scope: only the named references are resolved and staged; a neighbouring file in the same directory is never opened
security_summary.limits: Python ceilings are taken from MediaLimits; Node enforces the same 4 / 8 MiB / 16 MiB hard ceiling and a protocol may only narrow it
security_summary.cancellation: CANCELLED revokes the task's media, deletes staged files and never replays; the one unopened 401 auth recovery keeps the same model and the same image set and records image_input.sends=2 with automatic_replay=false
security_summary.usage: only upstream usage is reported; missing usage stays null with usage_state UNKNOWN and is never derived from image count
security_summary.completeness: a successful but truncated answer keeps complete=false/partial=true and image_input.complete=false; errors keep the partial text and usage they already have
security_summary.source_mapping: ORIGINAL_QUOTE, DERIVED_IMAGE, USER_INPUT and TEXT_SUMMARY are distinct; derived images keep source_sha256 -> sha256 conversion chains; citations only prove identifier registration and claim_verified is always false
security_summary.leak_control: errors and evidence carry counts, identifiers and hashes only, never image encoding, prompt text, staging paths or credentials; the transport's image_input block is merged through a fixed key whitelist
security_summary.network_during_preparation: the media boundary performs no network request; the model transport is the only outbound path

acceptance.case: existing single-turn and multi-turn text requests keep parameters and result type
a catalogue flag without transport evidence refuses instead of guessing the request body
another account, an expired reference or an over-limit selection produces zero fake remote requests
the send scope is exactly the selected text and images and never reads a neighbour file
unknown citation ids are flagged and known ids are never claimed as verified facts
cancellation or a stream interruption after output starts never triggers a second generation
missing usage and partial output keep UNKNOWN and incomplete states
logs, errors, progress and handover text carry no image encoding or prompt text
error codes and the module record stay consistent; tests are portable

cross_module_requests.request: Wire models.chat(media=..., protocols=...): build MediaAssets from the 2.1 temp_dir, a MediaBinding from the authenticated account pseudonym, a per-request task id and <temp_dir>/transport created 0700; expose the already-extended images argument on model_chat and add a description note that images need the media binding. Do not add another local read path or image_url/path field.

Register the 11 module codes in contracts/v0.2/error-classification.json: MODEL_REQUIRED_FOR_IMAGE_INPUT, MODEL_IMAGE_REQUIRES_MEDIA_PIPELINE, MODEL_IMAGE_SELECTION_INVALID, MODEL_IMAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, MODEL_IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED, MODEL_IMAGE_PROTOCOL_UNVERIFIED, MODEL_IMAGE_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE, MODEL_IMAGE_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE, MODEL_IMAGE_STAGING_FAILED, MODEL_IMAGE_STAGING_MISMATCH, MODEL_IMAGE_MESSAGES_INVALID. Until then source_state.public_error folds them to UNKNOWN/INTERNAL (audit P2-3).
Optionally attach model_media.capabilities(directory, protocols=...) rows to list_models; never promote a catalog flag to AVAILABLE.

Update docs/contracts/model-image.md to say that no profile ships by default and request construction is gated, while a registered profile does generate content parts; update contracts/v0.2/sources/source-registry.json code_refs to the 4.5 lines and split implementation_state into gate-implemented / production-transport-blocked (audit P2-13).

Document the gated image capability: with a media binding the call fails with MODEL_IMAGE_PROTOCOL_UNVERIFIED; the unwired MCP entry fails with MODEL_IMAGE_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE; text, catalog and the 29 tool entries are unchanged. 4.5 did not edit docs/CAPABILITIES.md because 4.1/4.2/4.3 share it and 7.3 owns the public manual.
Include tests/test_model_media.py in cross-platform regression; Node transport cases skip themselves when node is absent and the POSIX permission case skips on Windows.

A preview no longer creates a bundle, but a consume that fails after authorize can still leave one AUTHORIZED entry in ModelInputBroker._bundles until process exit; extend _prune to drop expired PREPARED/EXPIRED/AUTHORIZED entries.
Ship src/thu_assistant/model_media.py in the wheel (pure Python; no package-data entry needed).

blockers.impact: With an empty registry the image call refuses with MODEL_IMAGE_PROTOCOL_UNVERIFIED; without a media binding the MCP entry refuses with MODEL_IMAGE_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE. Text chat, the catalog and the existing 29 tool entries are unaffected.
blockers.resolution: Record a ProtocolProfile only after official documentation or an owner-authorized synthetic probe defines the request media shape, supported models, byte/pixel/count limits and error semantics.

open_cross_module.reason: contracts/v0.2/ is outside this module's writable paths; 11 codes remain unregistered and public_error folds them to UNKNOWN.
open_cross_module.mitigation: model_media.MODULE_CODES pins the exact list and a consistency test fails if the implementation and the list drift.

open_cross_module.reason: docs/contracts/ and contracts/v0.2/sources/ are outside this module's writable paths; the contract text still describes a text-only request and code_refs still point at the pre-4.5 lines.
open_cross_module.mitigation: Exact replacement wording and the required registry update are in cross_module_requests.

remaining_limits: The module's completion means the gate, preview, send path, source mapping and refusal paths are implemented and audited; it does not mean multimodal input works against the real school proxy.

Transport staging writes a second copy of already-sanitised image bytes beside the 3.3 cache: 0600 files under a 0700 root, deleted after a verified read or in finally; crash residue is removed by the next image request after 900 seconds, not by a background timer; no physical erasure is claimed.
The gateway stdin frame limit of 2 MiB is why inline base64 is not used; if 6.1 changes the framing protocol this decision must be re-checked.
Images attach only to the final user message; earlier assistant turns keep their original shape and images are never retro-inserted.
Protocol evidence is matched per exact model id with no wildcard; different proxy paths for one model need separate profiles.
Capability rows use the frozen model-image-capability-v1 object, so media types and limits live in preview.protocol rather than in the row.
Windows has no POSIX mode bits; staging privacy relies on the user-directory ACL and the module only rejects relative paths, symlinks and non-directories.
A 401 that arrives before output may resend the same images once for token refresh; the evidence records image_input.sends=2 and automatic_replay=false, and the model never changes.
The preview exposes the text scope (counts, roles, source ids) but not message bodies; a confirmation UI that shows the text is built by 6.1 on the caller side.
rollback: Stop injecting MediaBinding and ProtocolRegistry: image arguments then fail with MODEL_IMAGE_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE while text chat, the catalog and the 29 tool entries are unchanged. THU_MODEL_READ=0 still returns to the legacy single-prompt behaviour. Nothing is re-sent, and user files are never deleted.
next_step: The batch integrator reconnects 4.1-4.5 on one commit, runs the batch-level check, the full offline suite and contract linkage, and routes the open P2-3/P2-13 registrations to 6.1/2.3; the protocol-evidence blocker stays open until verified evidence exists.
